body.title: Reconcile duplicate lifecycle provenance
body.summary: Transition duplicate ISSUE-163e7bc3d6f0ccba and its LLD lineage to explicit superseded lifecycle state, bind replacement provenance to the primary standalone artifact, and preserve both records as historical non-routable evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Both duplicate artifacts read back as superseded with replacement provenance to the primary artifact and cannot be selected for new workflow routing.
The transition is atomic or safely retryable; any failed readback stops the build before source-light migration proceeds.
Existing primary PLAN/BUILD/TESTS evidence and completed task records remain unchanged.

tests.name: Duplicate ISSUE/LLD lifecycle reconciliation: atomic supersession, replacement provenance, non-routability, retry/readback failure, and unchanged primary PLAN/BUILD/TESTS evidence.
